backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that composes blob storage functionality via a MixinStorage mixin import.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two design-replacement features to their associated frontend files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-line summaries of each frontend source file describing the Verdant Studio creative agency redesign.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, card, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Verdant Studio creative design agency site, loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that assembles the full page layout by composing Header, HeroSection, ServicesSection, PhilosophySection, WorkSection, ProcessSection, ContactSection, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with contact details panel (email, phone, location) and a project inquiry form that shows a thank-you state on submission.
frontend/src/components/CoursesSection.t: Services section listing four offerings (Brand Identity, Web Design, Motion, Strategy) as a ruled hover list with mono tags and animated arrow icons on a cream background.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Dark footer featuring an animated marquee ticker, brand column with CTA, three-column link grid, and a bottom bar with dynamic year and attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive fixed header component for Verdant Studio with scroll-aware background, desktop nav links, a 'Start a Project' CTA, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a dot-grid background, animated decorative circles, headline, tagline, CTA buttons, and a stats panel on the right.
frontend/src/components/LibrarySection.t: Process section (exported as ProcessSection) displaying four numbered workflow steps—Discovery, Strategy, Design, Delivery—each with a duration and list of deliverables.
Work/portfolio section (exported as WorkSection) showing four recent projects in a two-column grid, each as a colored card with title, category, year, and description.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseSection: Philosophy section (exported as PhilosophySection) featuring a pull quote, a three-column values grid, and a bottom stat bar with studio metrics like founding year and client retention.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an Internet Computer actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a forest-green/cream/gold design system using CSS custom properties, Tailwind layers, and custom utility classes including typography, gradients, and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom brand colors (forest, cream, gold), display typography scales, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a full website rebuild away from the existing orange/glassmorphism SSC coaching site, with a new creative theme and a minimal empty Motoko backend.
